amendment.change: Require separately supplied frozen instrument with assignment validation; bind exact complete pre/post request objects including phase, questionnaire and allowed context
amendment.prior_runs: Preserved unchanged; superseded for request-integrity evidence only
amendment.reason: IA-E02-001: rehashed saved requests could change questionnaire or pre/post phase without rejection
amendment.scientific_gates: Unchanged; mock engineering only, independent re-audit pending

analysis.multiplicity: secondary/sensitivity outputs descriptive only, no confirmatory significance claims; primary inference requires frozen real-run analysis/audit
sensitivity: survey-weight mass removed and held-out joint support
analysis.small_cluster_limit: three purposively selected texts and a tiny profile pool do not support broad content or human-population inference
analysis.source_of_outcomes: raw pre/post answers rescored independently, not cached change fields or model interpretation
analysis.uncertainty: seeded crossed profile/stimulus percentile bootstrap; repetitions nested; 500 repetitions for engineering checks only

assignment.carryover: no cross-arm history; post request receives only its own baseline and assigned exposure
assignment.design: fully crossed 5 arms per profile x stimulus x repeat; seed randomized execution order
assignment.item_order: paired across arms within matched unit, randomized by pair seed
assignment.seed_guarantee: mock deterministic; hosted model determinism not assumed

conditions.C0: no policy text; repeated instrument control
conditions.C1: exact official-policy excerpt in a document/news-card text wrapper
conditions.C2: identical excerpt and source label in synthetic social-post text wrapper
conditions.C3: C1 plus fixed source-bounded scripted reference QA; live assistant contrast deferred
conditions.C4: C2 plus the identical scripted QA; live assistant contrast deferred

earned_complexity.demographics: require persona-free/party-only simpler comparators on identical profile IDs, stimuli, questionnaire, seeds, source cutoff and compute plan; not yet earned
earned_complexity.live_assistant: require fixed source-bounded prompts and matched-compute no-assistant controls; scripted QA is not sufficient
earned_complexity.real_text: candidate official text must pass independent rights/content audit
earned_complexity.social_wrapper: matched exact text and attribution; no personalized platform claim

exclusions.response_quality: missing/non-numeric/refusal/out-of-range/unexpected-field answers recorded; invalid C1/C2 pairs excluded with counts
exclusions.sampling: predeclared 25+ and fresh sample; sparse joint cells below five training records excluded and weighted loss reported
exclusions.stopping: engineering n=12 x 3 x 5 x 1 fixed; no outcome-driven extension; real pilot size and main-run power not derived from deterministic mock variance
exclusions.structural: empty/duplicate/incomplete assignment, changed party prior, request mismatch or cached-score disagreement rejects the run

instrument.response_domain: each item 0..100 or null; unknown, refusal and invalid values not imputed

live_execution.approval: affirmative owner budget and independent protocol/population/source gates required
live_execution.credentials: previously exposed credentials must be rotated and securely validated by owner; not used by worker
live_execution.main_sample_size: BLOCKED until genuine bounded model-pilot variance, budget and registered power/precision simulation are available
live_execution.model_provider: not approved/frozen for a live run
live_execution.pricing: fresh exact-provider snapshot and worst-case dispatch reservations required

population.base_prior: ANES fresh combined pre-election weighted, 25+, coarsened supported joint cells
population.calibration: 2024 ACS five-year region-age and region-education resident margins; race/income audit-only
population.holdout: fixed seed at survey PSU/stratum cluster level
population.scientific_gate: BLOCKED: citizen/resident mismatch and substantial unsupported survey mass; no representative electorate inference

primary_estimand.independents: retained for quality/absolute-gap secondary outputs; excluded from in-party primary by definition
primary_estimand.party_prior: fixed before exposure; never reclassified from post response
primary_estimand.weighting: equal complete eligible finite-pool units; no national average interpretation

primary_hypothesis.alternative: Two-sided nonzero paired mean difference. No directional success criterion is chosen from observed outcomes.
primary_hypothesis.null: Equal mean before/after in-party warmth-gap change under C2 and C1 for the same eligible profile-stimulus-repeat units.

provenance.definitions_change_rule: version and log any post-freeze change; a changed lock blocks verification; never rewrite prior run artifacts

stimulus_selection.forecast_reuse: DISALLOWED; publication clock unknown and no independent pre-results archive
stimulus_selection.rule: purposive public-domain original federal statute paragraphs, feasibility only

study_scope: Synthetic response behavior on a finite preselected fictional profile x official-policy-text pool; no human persuasion, actual feed exposure, state-representative or current-news inference.
